item.title: Version 1.0.0
item.description:
Version 1.0.0

The first release. Cargo puts your DDEV projects in the menu bar and keeps the disk they use under control.

  • Every project in the menu bar — start, stop and restart without a terminal, with live status, search, and Power Off All for when you want the machine back.
  • Quick Actions — up to five shortcuts on each project row: Start / Stop, Restart, Project Info, Open in Browser, Mailpit, TablePlus, Finder, Terminal, your editor, or your version control app. The rest stay in the row's ⋯ menu.
  • Cleanup — find the projects you haven't touched in months and reclaim what they're sitting on: node_modules, Composer vendor, and the Docker volumes and containers left behind. It also finds projects that exist only in Docker now, their code long since deleted.
  • Cleanup clears DDEV's shared cache — every project leaves a Node install and its shell history in ddev-global-cache, and DDEV walks all of it on every start. Left alone for long enough, that's what makes ddev start crawl and eventually time out. Cleanup finds the folders belonging to projects that are gone, and removes them with the rest.
  • Databases are backed up first — exported as a gzipped .sql before anything is removed, or archived straight from the volume when a project's containers are already gone. Nothing is deleted if the backup fails.
  • Diagnostics — Docker and DDEV status at a glance, with a Start Docker button and the prune commands that usually get things moving again.
  • Appearance — follow the system, or pin light or dark.
